p-section.p-paragraph: RetroGo is made possible by the open-source emulation community, the Libretro ecosystem, and independent homebrew game creators. We sincerely thank everyone whose work helps classic digital culture remain playable on modern devices.

RetroGo is built on RetroArch / Libretro technology and integrates multiple Libretro cores, each distributed under its own open-source license. For detailed core information and license texts, please refer to the "Core List" page inside the app.
The games below were used to prepare RetroGo App Store screenshots, demo captures, and related promotional materials. RetroGo does not provide commercial ROMs or BIOS files.
